status.active: listed on the roster or under recent signings
status.left: seen under recent releases and retirements after the last UFC fight
status.not_listed: not on the roster: 'has not fought in the UFC since <since>'

percentiles.direction: a percentile is the share of peers with a LOWER value: for metrics with better=low (sapm, ko_loss_share) a high percentile is the worse end
percentiles.definition: share of the other fighters in the pool with a lower value, ties half; current pool = active+suspended in the division with 5+ fights with a box score; archived profiles: pool on the date of the last fight = fighters of that division with 5+ such fights and a UFC fight in the window before it

str_acc.en: Share of significant strikes that land

str_def.en: Share of opponents' significant strikes avoided

td_acc.en: Share of takedown attempts that succeed

ctrl_share.en: Share of fight time in control

ko_loss_share.en: Share of UFC fights lost by KO/TKO (durability)

finish_share.en: Share of wins by KO/TKO or submission

notes: UFC record = [wins, losses, draws, no contests]. Draws and no-contests are known from 2013 (ufcstats sweep); earlier ones are not in the database.
Draws and no-contests count in the record, in fight time and in every per-minute rate; durability counts them as fights not lost by KO.
Fights without method or box score count in the record, not in any rate.
Judges of a draw or a no-contest: judges_unattributed (high/low score, no side) — ufcstats does not say whose number is whose for those.
Event location: ufcstats, events from 2013; null before.
'pro' record = ufcstats (all promotions) + our UFC results after its date; [wins, losses, draws].
rating: our own Elo over UFC results (meta.rating) — a rating, not a forecast; null when meta.rating.ready is false.

method.ru: Elo по боям UFC: старт 1500, победа над более сильным даёт больше очков; год без боя — без потерь, дальше отрыв от 1500 вдвое меньше каждые 3 месяца; ничья — половина победы, NC не в счёт.
method.en: Elo over UFC fights: everyone starts at 1500, beating a stronger opponent earns more; a year without a fight costs nothing, after that the distance from 1500 halves every 3 months; a draw is half a win, a no-contest does not count.

accuracy.population: fights with a winner where both fighters had 3+ earlier UFC fights; parameters chosen on fights before 2020, checked once on these (research/2026-11_rating_v2)

line.ru: Угадывает победителя в 57,8% боёв (2020–2026, 1 875 боёв, у обоих бойцов 3+ боя в UFC). Прогноз модели — отдельно.
line.en: Picks the winner in 57.8% of fights (2020–2026, 1,875 fights, both fighters with 3+ UFC fights). The model's forecast is separate.

scale.note: a rating difference d gives the higher-rated fighter 1 / (1 + 10^(-d/400)) by the rating

ranks.division: the fighter's last fight with a known division
ranks.archive: fighters not on the roster: the value after their last fight, no place

movement.event: UFC Fight Night: Cortes Acosta vs. Walker

note.ru: Последний бой больше года назад — рейтинг снижается за простой.
note.en: Last fight more than a year ago — the rating is fading for inactivity.
